# Gumroad API

REST API (v2) for a Gumroad creator account. Create an application under Settings > Advanced; for your own account, generate a personal access token there instead of running OAuth. Gumroad is the merchant of record for sales.

Researched · not yet run liveLast researched 25 October 2026 · Gumroad · [provider site](https://gumroad.com)

**Researched, not yet run live.** Built from the provider’s official pages (linked below). A person hasn’t walked this flow end to end yet, so check each step against the source.

## Who owns what

One Gumroad creator account. Applications (OAuth clients) live under the account's Settings > Advanced; a personal access token acts as the account.

- **Gumroad account** personal owned by the creator (person or business)
- **API application** developer · under Gumroad accountNeeded both for OAuth (third-party users) and to generate a personal access token.

## Have ready

- A Gumroad creator account selling products allowed by Gumroad's prohibited-products list

- **Government-issued ID and personal/tax details, if Gumroad or its payment processor asks.** · Gumroad may request legal name, address, date of birth, taxpayer ID, bank details and government ID, and may hold funds until provided. [3]Needed for: Fill in payout settings
- **Bank account (or another payout method) for payouts.** [3]Needed for: Fill in payout settings

## Steps

Steps marked “human step” are ones only you can do: verapli never signs in, submits, pays or accepts terms for you.

1. ### Create a Gumroad account

   The person signs up at Gumroad and accepts the terms.

   Where: https://gumroad.com/signup
2. ### Create an API application

   In Settings > Advanced, fill in the application form (name, redirect URI). For your own account only, the redirect URI can be http://127.0.0.1.

   verapli captures `GUMROAD_APPLICATION_ID` here by plain code: encrypted in your browser, never shown to AI.

   Where: https://gumroad.com/settings/advanced
3. ### Copy the application secret (OAuth only)optional

   If other Gumroad users will connect through OAuth, copy the application secret for the server-side token exchange. Not needed for a personal access token.

   verapli captures `GUMROAD_APPLICATION_SECRET` here by plain code: encrypted in your browser, never shown to AI.

   Where: https://gumroad.com/settings/advanced
4. ### Generate an access token for your own account

   Click "Generate access token" on the application. The token works until revoked; store it as a secret.

   verapli captures `GUMROAD_ACCESS_TOKEN` here by plain code: encrypted in your browser, never shown to AI.

   Where: https://gumroad.com/settings/advanced
5. ### Fill in payout settingsoptional

   Add payout details in the payout settings; Gumroad or its processor may ask for identity documents before paying out.

   If something goes wrong (1)

   - **Payouts held.**: Provide the verification information Gumroad requests; funds can be held until it is supplied. [3]

## Terms and gotchas

Plain-English summary, not legal advice. Each card links its source.

### Gumroad is the merchant of record

Gumroad is the merchant of record for the resale of your products; you may not invoice buyers directly; Gumroad sets the final resale price (from your suggested price), handles first-tier refunds/chargebacks, and collects and remits indirect tax. [3]

### Prohibited products

Prohibited include restricted goods (alcohol, tobacco, weapons), adult content and dating, AI services fulfilled outside Gumroad (AI tools, chatbots, generation subscriptions), crypto/NFTs and monetizable credits, financial and money services, get-rich-quick and credit-repair schemes, gambling and betting tips, pharmaceuticals, pirated goods, hacking and game cheats, fake IDs, bulk marketing tools and email lists, MLM, food/plants/seeds, jewelry and beauty products, and more. [4]

### Holds, reserves and discretionary termination

Gumroad may hold payouts for risk reasons with no fixed maximum, applies a 25% rolling 90-day reserve if the refund rate exceeds 15%, and may suspend or terminate accounts at any time in its sole discretion. [3]

### No scraping or excessive load

The terms prohibit automated scraping, crawling or data mining and imposing excessive load; API use should stay within normal application behaviour. [3]

## What you end up with

| Env var | Secret | Format | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GUMROAD_ACCESS_TOKEN` | secret | `opaque token string (shape only)` | Access token for your own Gumroad account; does not expire until revoked. |
| `GUMROAD_APPLICATION_ID` | not secret | `opaque id string` | OAuth application id (client id). |
| `GUMROAD_APPLICATION_SECRET` | secret | `opaque secret string (shape only)` | OAuth application secret (server side only). |

## Pricing

- Free tier: No monthly fee.
- Costs: 10% + $0.50 per direct sale; 30% per Discover sale.

Source [5]
